components.name: Reference Band
components.description: Signature: sector percentile axis, middle-half band, median tick, company dot.

narrative.overview: The panel reads a company the way a lab report reads a blood test: a value, the reference range it should be judged against, and a marker only when it falls outside. One light ground, ink and hairline rules, big condensed numerals. Emphasis comes from scale and weight, never colour; colour is reserved for the sign of a change.
keyCharacteristics: One light ground (#f7f8f7), no cards, sections opened by a 2px ink rule.
Archivo condensed heavy for numbers, Archivo normal width for UI, tabular figures everywhere.
The reference band (sector 25–75th percentile) with median tick and company dot is the signature.
Signed values always carry a drawn ▲/▼ as well as colour.
Cobalt brand (#1d4ed8, shared with the demo deck) for logo, active tab, links, range band and dots.
The hero field takes the direction's colour: a red wash when real growth falls, green when it rises.

rules.name: The Meaning Colours Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is structure, green/red is direction, amber is attention. No other hue, and none of them as decoration.

rules.name: The Colour Is Law Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only on a signed change or a crossed threshold, never as brand, decoration, or a good/bad verdict on a percentile.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number uses tabular figures and Turkish formatting.

rules.name: The Ruled Page Rule
rules.body: No cards, no bordered boxes; a section is a rule, a title and content.

dos: Do open every section with the 2px ink rule and a 17px title.
Do put the real figure first and large, nominal and inflation beside it and small.
Do draw icons and signs as SVG in one stroke weight.
Do keep the disclaimer and data-source line visible.
donts: Don't reintroduce cards, glass, glows, gradients or indigo/emerald accents.
Don't colour a percentile, trend or out-of-band marker green/red; position is not a verdict.
Don't use Unicode glyphs or emoji as icons.
Don't load fonts or scripts from a CDN; the panel must run offline.
Don't strip the page back to black and white; the meaning colours are part of the identity.
